title: Porous graphene frameworks pillared by organic linkers with tunable surface area and gas storage properties
material_description: PGF-1 | porous (pillared) graphene framework: NaBH4-reduced graphene oxide (graphite oxide by modified Hummers method) functionalized with iodobenzene via the in-situ diazonium salt of 4-iodoaniline (RGO-IBz), then covalently pillared by Pd(PPh3)4/CuI Sonogashira C-C coupling in DMF/triethylamine at 140 C for 48 h with 1,4-diethynylbenzene as the pillar
